A Little Story Behind Every Sip

Deja Brew is inspired by déjà vu, that familiar, comforting moment you want to live again. We reinterpret it as a good feeling: a café you will always want to come back to.

Coffee is more than a drink. It can be part of a memory, a peaceful afternoon, a meaningful conversation, or a small moment of happiness. That is why our café is cozy, romantic and welcoming, with blush pink, warm mocha and cream all around.

Come for the coffee. Stay for the comfort. Leave with a feeling worth repeating.

Personal touches

Handwritten affirmations, personalized cup sleeves, and loyalty cards with a little extra thought.

Familiar favorites, plus something new

A varied menu with a monthly limited-edition drink to look forward to.

A space to settle in

For studying, working, solo dates, romantic dates, and spontaneous hangouts with friends.

Offer terms

  1. Purchase at least one regular-priced signature drink in a single transaction.
  2. Show the official campaign post before payment.
  3. Receive one complimentary affirmation cup sleeve per transaction.
  4. The offer is available while supplies last.
  5. The complimentary item is not redeemable for cash.
  6. The offer cannot be combined with other promotions.
  7. Past purchases are not eligible.

The offer applies to the cup sleeve only; there is no free drink with purchase. Campaign dates and terms are proposed for this academic project.

Where to find us

Proposed location: Cabuyao City, Laguna, near a college or a busy commercial area in Pulo or Banay-Banay.

Proposed hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM. Saturday and Sunday, 9:00 AM–10:00 PM.

Location and hours are proposed in our marketing plan and may change with the final business site.
